messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished to eu-central: service/inference v2.40.0 -> v2.41.0 (rollout 10%) commit c0ffee99. canary probes running.

asha: quick flag ~60s after rollout our synthetic rate-limit probe for /v1/embeddings started returning 429s from eu-central. not massive but a clear spike.

sre-max: Can you paste the probe histogram? is it per-host or global?

asha: per-host breakdown: spike concentrated on eu-central-host-3 and host-8. overall 429 rate in canary ~0.9% over 2m window.

ops-sam: Any changes to the new release that touch the internal rate-limiter or proxy headers?

asha: Nothing obvious in release notes, but the new handler adds aggressive per-connection token refill logic. Could be interacting poorly with envoy-rate-limiter config.

release-rhea: Pause rollout. No further batches.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by release-rhea.

sre-max: Recommendation: pin region routing back to previous release while we triage and avoid broad rollback. Runbook (infra-admin):
```bash
routectl set-route --region eu-central --target release:v2.40.0 --weight 100 --reason "post-deploy synth 429 spike"
```

ops-sam: Also quarantine the two hosts from LB until we confirm. Quick LB commands:
```bash
lbctl remove-backend --region eu-central --backend eu-central-host-3
lbctl remove-backend --region eu-central --backend eu-central-host-8
```

deploy-bot: Route change applied: eu-central -> release:v2.40.0 (effective). Hosts queued for quarantine.

asha: After diversion synth 429s dropped to baseline within 45s. No customer tickets so far. Captured envoy / rate-limiter logs from host-3 showing bursts of token rejections and X-Envoy-RateLimit-Status: over-limit.

sre-max: Initial hypothesis: the new code subtly changed request pacing which caused transient token depletion on a per-host rate limiter. Follow-ups: 1) add per-host rate-limit telemetry to canary checks, 2) add a canary gating rule that fails rollout if per-host 429>0.5% over 2m, 3) open INF-4801 to track tuning and small patch to handler.

product-evan: Please add a short release note: "eu-central rollout paused after probe-detected 429s on a subset of hosts; region routing reverted to v2.40.0 while we investigate." I'll prep customer messaging if needed.

release-rhea: Marking release as "paused - eu-central reverted" and creating INF-4801 with owner=@asha. Closing thread for now.
